**Finding submitted — deviation (§ 19, p0133).**

Section 19 was a mutual **no-hire** (not a non-solicit) reaching *any* employee of the other party plus recently departed project personnel, running for the term plus one year, with no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. A no-hire covering all personnel is walk-away territory under NOSOLICIT, so it fails the fallback.

The single surgical replacement brings § 19 to the fallback bargain: mutual non-solicitation, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, 12 months from the end of that involvement, with express carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches and no prohibition on hiring. No other clause in the document imposes a solicitation or hiring restriction.
